posts.author: Luke
posts.title: Roleplay>Rules
posts.html:
There has been a lot of discussion over the rules on the experiment RP server, no options seem to favor any side.

My suggestion is make it a serious RP.
This means
A hell of a lot of /me's
Proper grammar and spelling.
Proper Roleplay behavior (this should be enforced by punishment)
Basically, according to TNB's roleplaying guides (except not HL2 RP)

It's simple. You gotta be a good Roleplayer (On a roleplay server? Dear jebus tell me this isn't happening) Or you don't play.

I realize that people play VM for the light RP and all that but when there is a lack of rules ROLEPLAY MUST TAKE OVER.
Or it becomes deathmatching and frustration

Please seriously consider my suggestion, Because the way the server is now just can't continue
